column1: # Corpus garbage interception filter — `(code, word)` pairs that
# must NOT enter `weights.tsv` when regenerating from upstream
# Purpose (long-term design call 2026-06-03 per user directive
# "我不认为我们的源码中还应该存在有别人来源命名的 corpus，导入过程
# 应该是落在'吸收'，在那时候就要做好去重、解决冲突以及拦截垃圾"):
# upstream corpora (jieba phrase tables, SUBTLEX, mozc, etc.) ship
# with noise that polish-log has flagged as wrong. Instead of
# letting that noise re-enter `weights.tsv` every time
# `pinyin-build-weights` regenerates from corpora, this file holds
# the running list of "we already judged this garbage, do not
# re-admit". The absorption pipeline (not yet wired) will consult
# this filter before writing a row.
# This file does NOT participate in the polish-rebuild chain — it
# is consumed only at full corpus regen time. Today, when a polish
# action does a D1 delete (remove the row from weights.tsv
# directly), we ALSO append a row here. The dual-record keeps the
# to consult this file is corpus-治理 phase work, scheduled for
# the next regen cycle. For now this is an audit log of D1
# decisions; populating it preserves the intent.

column1: # 2026-06-03 user: "mo 第三个万是哪来的" — 万 standard pinyin is "wan",
# corpus noise (legacy ingest absorbed via weighted merge, no per-row
# provenance to trace which upstream introduced it). freq 45834 was high
# enough to land at #2 in mo top-10. D1 delete + future-proof entry.
# 2026-06-03 user: "剑持 这不是个词" — character-by-character literal
# pinyin concat (剑 jiàn + 持 chí), not a real Chinese word. jieba/corpus
# noise. D1 delete from library.tsv + future-proof entry.
# 2026-06-04 user: "tuli 土里、图里、土利,埋在土里这时候土里才有点意义".
# 土里 / 图里 / 土粒 are jieba sub-word / forced concatenation noise —
# 土里 only meaningful in 埋在土里, 图里 only in compounds like
# 图里有, 土粒 is forced 土+粒 not a 词.  D1 delete from library.tsv.
# Real word 图利 (图谋利益) and 图例 (legend) kept.
# 2026-06-05 user: "jianti 间体 不是个词". Standalone 间体 doesn't
# exist as a Chinese word — appears only as substring of compounds
# like 中间体 (chemistry: intermediate) / 空间体系 (spatial system),
# which are their own dict entries and unaffected by this delete.
# 2026-06-06 user: "jiaozhu 叫朱 较著 椒猪 交住 这些都不算是中文词汇吧".
# All four are jieba 主词典 sub-word noise from the 24757-row pinyin
# legacy external ingest (digest_log.toml event 结巴中文分词词典
# 主词典 dict.txt). None standalone Chinese words:
#   叫朱  字字直拼 jiào+zhū
#   较著  古汉语残留, "更显著" 词缀感, 现代无独立用法
#   椒猪  字字直拼 jiāo+zhū
#   交住  字字直拼 jiāo+zhù (close to 抓住/接住 but not a real word)
# Real jiaozhu words preserved: 教主/叫住/浇筑/脚注/校注/浇铸.
# jianma 捡骂 — jieba sub-word noise (捡+骂 verb-verb concat, not a real word).
# User 2026-06-06: "捡骂 剑麻 不应该出现，他们不是词".
# 2026-06-06 systemic wubi 繁体 sweep — user "拼音[corrected→五笔]结果中有
# 很多繁体的结果，这肯定不是 nihongokanji 打出来的" → "詞要的不是沉，而是
# 不应该有，要打开繁体模式才能有" → "你系统解决吧".  Deleted every (code,
# trad_word) entry from wubi/library.tsv where opencc t2s(trad_word) !=
# trad_word AND the same code already has a simplified peer.  Orphan TRAD
# entries (no same-code simp peer, ~2953 of them) preserved — deleting
# them silently kills wubi lookup for those chars; wait for the 繁体-mode
